create-hierarchical-pdf-bookmarks.title: Create Hierarchical Bookmarks in a PDF
create-hierarchical-pdf-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to bind an existing PDF with PdfBookmarkEditor and add a multi‑level bookmark hierarchy (chapters and sections) before saving the document.

merge-pdf-bookmarks.title: Merge Bookmarks from One PDF into Another
merge-pdf-bookmarks.description: Shows how to export bookmarks from a source PDF to an XML stream and import them into a target PDF, preserving their order, using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-csv.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to CSV
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-csv.description: Opens a PDF, extracts all bookmarks recursively using PdfBookmarkEditor, and writes each bookmark's title, destination, and hierarchy level to a CSV file.

update-bookmark-destination-to-page-10.title: Update Bookmark Destination to Page 10
update-bookmark-destination-to-page-10.description: Shows how to locate a PDF bookmark by its title and change its destination to page 10 using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor facade.

delete-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.title: Delete All Bookmarks from PDF
delete-all-bookmarks-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove every bookmark from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfBookmarkEditor facade and save the cleaned file.

delete-bookmark-from-pdf.title: Delete Bookmark from PDF Using PdfBookmarkEditor
delete-bookmark-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF to PdfBookmarkEditor, listing existing bookmarks, deleting a specific bookmark by title, verifying the removal, and saving the updated document.

add-top-level-blue-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add Top-Level Blue Bookmark to PDF
add-top-level-blue-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a top‑level bookmark that points to the first page of a PDF and set its title color to blue using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-subbookmarks-to-pdf-chapter.title: Add Subbookmarks to a PDF Chapter
add-subbookmarks-to-pdf-chapter.description: Shows how to create a parent bookmark and attach child bookmarks to represent sections within a chapter of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

extract-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.title: Extract PDF Bookmarks to JSON
extract-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor to extract PDF bookmarks, build a hierarchical POCO model, and serialize it as indented JSON.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-xml.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to XML
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and export its complete bookmark hierarchy to an XML file.

import-bookmarks-from-json.title: Import Bookmarks from JSON into a PDF
import-bookmarks-from-json.description: Demonstrates how to read a JSON file containing bookmark definitions, map them to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Bookmark objects (including nested children), and add them to a PDF using PdfBookmarkEditor.

add-toc-bookmark-to-pdfs-batch.title: Add Table of Contents Bookmark to PDFs in Batch
add-toc-bookmark-to-pdfs-batch.description: Shows how to process all PDF files in a directory and add a top‑level "Table of Contents" bookmark to each document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

validate-pdf-bookmark-count.title: Validate PDF Bookmark Count After Adding Bookmarks
validate-pdf-bookmark-count.description: Demonstrates how to add a bookmark for each page using PdfBookmarkEditor, save the PDF, then extract and verify the total number of bookmarks.

update-pdf-bookmark-title.title: Update PDF Bookmark Title Using MemoryStream
update-pdf-bookmark-title.description: Shows how to bind a PDF from a byte array with MemoryStream, modify a bookmark title using PdfBookmarkEditor, and return the edited PDF as a byte array.

add-external-url-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add External URL Bookmarks to PDF
add-external-url-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create PDF bookmarks that open external web addresses using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

convert-bookmark-titles-to-title-case.title: Convert PDF Bookmark Titles to Title Case with Proper Noun Preservation
convert-bookmark-titles-to-title-case.description: Demonstrates how to read PDF bookmarks, convert each title to title case while keeping predefined proper nouns unchanged, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-bookmarks-matching-regex.title: Delete Bookmarks Matching a Regex Pattern
delete-bookmarks-matching-regex.description: Demonstrates how to remove PDF bookmarks whose titles match a specified regular expression using Aspose.Pdf.Facades. The example extracts bookmarks, filters them with a regex, and deletes the matching entries.

collapse-specific-pdf-bookmarks.title: Collapse Specific PDF Bookmarks Using Aspose.Pdf
collapse-specific-pdf-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to set selected PDF bookmarks to a collapsed (closed) state by extracting, modifying, and re‑creating the bookmark hierarchy with Aspose.Pdf.

adjust-pdf-bookmarks-after-inserting-pag.title: Adjust PDF Bookmarks After Inserting Pages
adjust-pdf-bookmarks-after-inserting-pag.description: Shows how to extract existing bookmarks, insert blank pages at the beginning of a PDF, and recreate the bookmarks with corrected page numbers using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-text.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to Text Outline
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-text.description: Shows how to extract the hierarchical bookmarks from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfBookmarkEditor and write them to a plain‑text file with indentation that reflects each bookmark level.

import-ofd-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Import OFD File and Add Bookmarks to PDF
import-ofd-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an OFD document, converting each page into a PDF bookmark, and saving the result as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-bookmark-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Bookmark to PDF
add-javascript-bookmark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF bookmark that runs JavaScript code when clicked using the Aspose.Pdf Facade API.

batch-delete-bookmarks-from-encrypted-pd.title: Batch Delete Bookmarks from Encrypted PDFs
batch-delete-bookmarks-from-encrypted-pd.description: Shows how to open password‑protected PDF files, remove all bookmarks using PdfBookmarkEditor, and save the cleaned documents.

rename-pdf-bookmarks-using-translation-d.title: Rename PDF Bookmarks Using a Translation Dictionary
rename-pdf-bookmarks-using-translation-d.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, renaming its bookmarks according to a translation dictionary, and saving the updated file with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

validate-pdf-bookmarks-against-toc.title: Validate PDF Bookmarks Against Table of Contents
validate-pdf-bookmarks-against-toc.description: Demonstrates extracting PDF bookmarks with PdfBookmarkEditor and comparing their page numbers to an expected table of contents for consistency checks.

add-image-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add Image Bookmarks to PDF
add-image-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Scans a PDF for images, records each image's page number, and creates a bookmark that links directly to the page containing the image using Aspose.Pdf.

set-bookmark-zoom-level-150-percent.title: Set Bookmark Zoom Level to 150% in PDF
set-bookmark-zoom-level-150-percent.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, traverse its bookmark tree, and set each bookmark's zoom factor to 150% so that pages open at the desired magnification from the outline.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-excel.title: Export PDF Bookmarks to Excel
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-excel.description: Shows how to extract all bookmarks from a PDF using PdfBookmarkEditor, place them in a table, and save the data as an Excel workbook via ExcelSaveOptions.

import-bookmarks-from-csv.title: Import Bookmarks from CSV into PDF
import-bookmarks-from-csv.description: Shows how to read a CSV file, build a hierarchical bookmark tree, and add the bookmarks to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

create-bookmark-to-named-destination.title: Create Bookmark to Named Destination in PDF
create-bookmark-to-named-destination.description: Shows how to add a bookmark that points to an existing named destination within a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-duplicate-bookmarks.title: Remove Duplicate Bookmarks from PDF
remove-duplicate-bookmarks.description: Shows how to extract all bookmarks, filter out duplicates based on title and page number, delete the existing outline, and recreate only the unique bookmarks using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-reviewed-bookmark-to-pdfs.title: Batch Add "Reviewed" Bookmark to PDFs
batch-add-reviewed-bookmark-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files in a directory, use PdfBookmarkEditor to create a "Reviewed" bookmark on the last page of each document, and save the updated PDFs.

add-colored-bookmarks-to-pdf.title: Add Colored Bookmarks to PDF Sections
add-colored-bookmarks-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create PDF bookmarks and set their title color (red for warnings, green for informational parts) using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.title: Export PDF Bookmark Hierarchy to JSON
export-pdf-bookmarks-to-json.description: Shows how to extract the bookmark tree from a PDF using PdfBookmarkEditor and write each bookmark's title, level, and page number to a JSON file.

import-bookmarks-from-database.title: Import Bookmarks from Database into PDF
import-bookmarks-from-database.description: Shows how to read bookmark records (title and page number) from a simulated database query and add them to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's bookmark editor.
